title: Privacy Policy
body:
Draft for legal review. This policy describes how personal data is handled on this website. It is written to match the website's actual data practices and should be reviewed by a qualified lawyer, including for compliance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and any other law that applies to you.

Who we are

This website is operated by or on behalf of Dr. Anameka S Panda ("we", "us"). [PLACEHOLDER: legal entity name and registered address.]

What we collect

  • Enquiry and booking forms: name, phone number, email address (optional on contact form), selected service, consultation mode, preferred date and time, and your message.
  • Consultation details you choose to share: for example birth details, floor plans or handwriting samples. Please share only what is needed.
  • Newsletter: your email address and the date you subscribed.
  • Technical data: a salted, one-way hash of your IP address for spam and abuse prevention. We do not store your raw IP address with your enquiry.
  • Analytics (only with consent): pages visited, device and browser type, approximate location and interactions, collected through Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.

Why we use it

  • To respond to enquiries and arrange and deliver consultations, on the basis of your consent and your request.
  • To send the newsletter you subscribed to; you can unsubscribe at any time.
  • To protect the website from spam and misuse.
  • To understand how the website is used and improve it, only if you accept analytics cookies.

Who we share it with

We use service providers to run the website: Supabase (database and authentication), Cloudinary (media hosting), Resend (email notifications), Google (analytics, only with consent; maps on the contact page) and WhatsApp (if you choose to message us there). Each processes data under its own terms. We do not sell personal data.

International transfers

Some providers may store data outside India. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm hosting regions selected for Supabase and Cloudinary.]

How long we keep it

Enquiries are kept for up to [PLACEHOLDER: e.g. 24] months after the last contact unless you ask us to delete them sooner or a law requires us to keep them longer. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

Your rights

You may ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, withdraw consent, or raise a grievance. We will respond within the period required by law. [PLACEHOLDER: name and contact of grievance officer, if applicable.]

Children

This website is not directed at children. A consultation for a minor should be requested by a parent or guardian.

Security

We use encrypted connections, access controls and role-based permissions. No system is perfectly secure, so please avoid sending highly sensitive information through the forms.

Changes

We will update this page when our practices change and revise the "last reviewed" date.

For any question about this policy, contact us using the details on the Contact page.

title: Terms & Conditions
body:

About these terms

They are not medical, psychological, legal, financial or engineering advice, and no specific outcome is promised. Please read the Disclaimer.

Bookings

A request submitted through the website is not a confirmed appointment until we confirm it with you. Fees, duration and payment terms are communicated at confirmation. [PLACEHOLDER: fee schedule and payment methods.]

title: Disclaimer
body:
Vedic astrology, Vastu Shastra, graphology, graphotherapy, numerology-based analyses and related remedial practices are traditional knowledge systems. Their methods are not established by scientific evidence.

Consultations and articles on this website are offered for guidance, reflection and educational purposes. They are not a substitute for advice from qualified medical, mental health, legal, financial, tax, structural or other professionals. Never delay or stop professional treatment or advice because of something you read here or heard in a consultation.

No consultation, remedy or suggestion guarantees any particular result. Testimonials and success stories describe individual experiences shared with permission; they do not mean you will have the same experience.

If you are in crisis or need urgent help, contact local emergency services or a qualified professional immediately.

title: Cookie Policy
body:
Draft for legal review.

What cookies we use

  • Essential: remembering your cookie choice, and secure sign-in for site administrators. These are always on.

Changing your choice

Use the "Cookie settings" link in the footer at any time to change your choice.
